children: Four Leaf Acquisition entered into a Business Combination Agreement with Data443 to execute a two-step merger creating NewCo. Each Four Leaf share will convert into NewCo stock, and Data443 will merge into a Four Leaf subsidiary, becoming a NewCo unit. Merger consideration is based on Data443’s equity value at a $10.00 reference price, capped at 60,000,000 NewCo shares, with customary closing conditions and escrow for indemnity claims. Data443 plans to convert at least $10 million of debt into equity ahead of closing.
